question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Epitome."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Opposite.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Epitome" means a perfect example of a particular quality or type. (नमूना)

 

• "Opposite" means a person or thing that is completely different from or contrary to another. It is therefore the correct antonym. (विपरीत)

◦ Example: His calm and quiet nature was the complete opposite of his loud and energetic brother.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Quintessence (सार तत्व) — the most perfect example of a quality; a synonym of epitome.

• Option 3: Personification (मूर्त रूप) — a person regarded as showing a quality perfectly; a synonym of epitome.

• Option 4: Embodiment (प्रतिरूप) — a tangible representation of an idea or quality; a synonym of epitome.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of epitome: Contrast, Antithesis, Reverse.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Fallacy (गलत धारणा): Truth (सत्य), Fact (तथ्य)

2. Falter (हिचकना): Persist (दृढ़ रहना), Continue (जारी रखना)

3. Fancy (सजावटी): Simple (सरल), Plain (सादा)

4. Fastidious (अत्यंत सावधान): Sloppy (लापरवाह), Careless (बेपरवाह)

5. Felicitous (उपयुक्त): Unfortunate (दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण), Inappropriate (अनुचित)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Former".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Current.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Former" means having been so in the past; previous. (पूर्व)

◦ Example: The former president delivered a speech reflecting on his years in national politics.

 

• "Current" means happening or existing at the present time, and is therefore the correct antonym. (वर्तमान)

◦ Example: The current situation demands urgent attention from policymakers before the crisis worsens further.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Prior (पूर्ववर्ती): coming before in time or order — a synonym of former, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Past (भूतकालीन): gone by in time; no longer current — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Previous (पिछला): existing or occurring before the present one — close in sense to former.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of former: Previous, Prior, Past, Erstwhile, Ex.

• Synonyms of current: Present, Contemporary, Existing, Prevailing.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Felicity (सुख): Misery (दुःख), Unhappiness (असंतोष)

2. Fertile (उपजाऊ): Barren (बंजर), Desolate (उजाड़)

3. Fetid (बदबूदार): Fragrant (सुगंधित), Pleasant (सुखद)

4. Fetish (अत्यधिक लगाव): Indifference (उदासीनता), Detachment (विरक्ति)

5. Feud (झगड़ा): Harmony (सामंजस्य), Peace (शांति)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Lachrymose."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Jovial.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Lachrymose" means tending to cry; tearful or mournful. (आँसू भरा)

 

• "Jovial" means cheerful and friendly; full of good humour. It is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रसन्न)

◦ Example: Despite the long journey, the jovial tour guide kept the passengers entertained with cheerful stories and jokes.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Weepy (रोने वाला) — tending to weep easily; a synonym of lachrymose.

• Option 3: Mournful (शोकाकुल) — expressing sorrow or grief; a synonym of lachrymose.

• Option 4: Tearful (आंसू भरा) — inclined to cry or full of tears; a synonym of lachrymose.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of lachrymose: Cheerful, Merry, Joyful.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Fictitious (काल्पनिक): Real (वास्तविक), Factual (तथ्यात्मक)

2. Fidelity (वफादारी): Treachery (विश्वासघात), Disloyalty (बेईमानी)

3. Fiendish (दुष्ट): Friendly (मित्रवत), Kind (दयालु)

4. Filthy (गंदा): Clean (साफ), Pure (शुद्ध)

5. Flee (भागना): Stay (रुकना), Remain (ठहरना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Peevish."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Pleasant.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Peevish" means easily irritated; having a bad temper. (चिड़चिड़ा)

 

• "Pleasant" means giving a sense of happy satisfaction or enjoyment; agreeable. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सुखद)

◦ Example: We spent a pleasant afternoon walking through the garden and chatting with old friends.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Testy (तुनकमिजाज़) — easily annoyed; impatient; a synonym of peevish.

• Option 2: Cranky (खीजा हुआ) — irritable or bad-tempered; a synonym of peevish.

• Option 3: Irritable (क्रोधी) — easily annoyed or angered; a synonym of peevish.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of peevish: Cheerful, Agreeable, Amiable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Flexible (लचीला): Rigid (कठोर), Stiff (सख्त)

2. Florid (चमकदार): Plain (साधारण), Pale (फीका)

3. Foment (उकसाना): Quash (दबाना), Suppress (रोकना)

4. Foolish (मूर्ख): Wise (बुद्धिमान), Sensible (समझदार)

5. Forbade (मनाही की): Allowed (अनुमति दी), Permitted (इजाजत दी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Dependence."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Autonomy.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Dependence" means the state of relying on someone or something for support. (निर्भरता)

 

• "Autonomy" means the right or condition of self-governance; independence. It is therefore the correct antonym. (स्वतंत्रता)

◦ Example: The region was granted greater autonomy to manage its own local affairs without constant central government interference.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Reliance (निर्भरता) — the state of depending on something; a synonym of dependence.

• Option 3: Need (आवश्यकता) — a requirement for something essential; a synonym of dependence.

• Option 4: Attachment (लगाव) — an emotional bond or fondness; a synonym of dependence.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of dependence: Independence, Freedom, Self-sufficiency.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Forbid (मना करना): Allow (अनुमति देना), Permit (इजाजत देना)

2. Forbidden (निषिद्ध): Allowed (अनुमति), Permitted (स्वीकृत)

3. Foremost (सबसे महत्वपूर्ण): Unimportant (महत्वहीन), Minor (छोटा)

4. Forever (हमेशा): Temporarily (अस्थायी), Briefly (संक्षेप में)

5. Forgive (माफ़ करना): Loathe (घृणा करना), Condemn (दोष देना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Vilify".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Commend.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Vilify" means speak or write about someone in an abusively disparaging manner. (बदनाम करना)

◦ Example: The tabloid newspapers continued to vilify the actress long after the scandal had been resolved.

 

• "Commend" means praise formally or officially; express approval of, and is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रशंसा करना)

◦ Example: The principal decided to commend the students publicly for their outstanding performance in the science fair.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Slander (मानहानि करना): make false and damaging statements about someone — a synonym of vilify, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Defame (बदनाम करना): damage the good reputation of someone — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Malign (निंदा करना): speak ill of someone in a spiteful manner — close in sense to vilify.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of vilify: Defame, Malign, Slander, Denigrate, Disparage.

• Synonyms of commend: Praise, Applaud, Laud, Compliment, Extol.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Forgo (त्यागना): Conquer (प्राप्त करना/जीतना)

2. Former (पूर्व): Current (वर्तमान), Present (वर्तमान)

3. Fortunately (सौभाग्य से): Unfortunately (दुर्भाग्य से), Sadly (दुखद)

4. Frighten (डराना): Comfort (सांत्वना देना), Calm (शांत करना)

5. Frugal (मितव्ययी): Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Sell."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Buy.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Sell" means to give something in exchange for money. (बेचना)

 

• "Buy" means to obtain something by paying money for it. It is therefore the correct antonym. (खरीदना)

◦ Example: Many customers prefer to buy groceries online rather than visiting a physical store.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Market (बाज़ार में बेचना) — to offer goods for sale; a synonym of sell.

• Option 2: Trade (व्यापार करना) — to buy and sell goods commercially; a synonym of sell.

• Option 3: Vend (बेचना) — to sell goods, especially in small amounts; a synonym of sell.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of sell: Purchase, Acquire, Procure.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Furtive (गुप्त): Open (खुला), Overt (स्पष्ट)

2. Futile (व्यर्थ): Effective (प्रभावी), Useful (उपयोगी)

3. Gaining (प्राप्त करना): Losing (खोना), Forfeiting (त्यागना)

4. Garner (इकट्ठा करना): Disperse (बिखेरना), Scatter (फैलाना)

5. Garrulous (बातूनी): Reserved (संकोची), Quiet (शांत)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Dexterity."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Ignorance.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Dexterity" means skill in performing tasks, especially with the hands. (निपुणता)

 

• "Ignorance" means lack of knowledge, information, or skill about something. It is therefore the correct antonym. (अज्ञान)

◦ Example: His sheer ignorance of basic traffic rules nearly caused a serious accident on the busy highway.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Proficiency (दक्षता) — a high degree of competence; a synonym of dexterity.

• Option 2: Agility (फुर्ती) — the ability to move quickly and easily; a synonym of dexterity.

• Option 4: Skill (निपुणता) — the ability to do something well; a synonym of dexterity.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of dexterity: Clumsiness, Ineptitude, Awkwardness.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Get back (वापस पाना): Lose (खो देना), Miss (गंवा देना)

2. Get on (चढ़ना): Remain (रुकना), Stay (ठहरना)

3. Give away (दे देना): Keep (रखना), Save (बचाना)

4. Give back (वापस करना): Keep (रखना), Retain (संभालकर रखना)

5. Give up (हार मानना): Persist (डटे रहना), Continue (जारी रखना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Barren."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Fertile.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Barren" means too poor to produce much or any vegetation; infertile. (बंजर)

 

• "Fertile" means producing or capable of producing abundant vegetation or crops. It is therefore the correct antonym. (उपजाऊ)

◦ Example: The fertile plains along the river supported rich harvests of wheat and rice throughout the year.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Infertile (अनुपजाऊ) — not able to produce crops or vegetation; a synonym of barren.

• Option 3: Arid (शुष्क) — having little or no rain; too dry to support vegetation; a synonym of barren.

• Option 4: Desolate (वीरान) — deserted and bleak; empty of life; a synonym of barren.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of barren: Productive, Congested, Fruitful.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Glanced (झलक देखना): Stared (घूरना), Gazed (टकटकी लगाना)

2. Glut (भरमार): Starve (भूखा रहना), Shortage (कमी)

3. Go on (जारी रखना): Stop (रोकना), Cease (बंद करना)

4. Grabbed (पकड़ लिया): Release (छोड़ना), Let go (मुक्त करना)

5. Gracious (दयालु): Miserable (दुखी/कठोर)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Forever."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Temporarily.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Forever" means for all future time; without ever ending. (हमेशा)

 

• "Temporarily" means for a limited time only; not permanently. It is therefore the correct antonym. (अस्थायी)

◦ Example: The office was temporarily closed for renovation while the new furniture was being installed.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Permanently (स्थायी रूप से) — in a way that lasts forever; a synonym of forever.

• Option 3: Eternally (शाश्वत रूप से) — for all time; endlessly; a synonym of forever.

• Option 4: Perpetually (निरंतर) — continuing forever without interruption; a synonym of forever.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of forever: Briefly, Momentarily, Fleetingly.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Grapple (पकड़ना): Release (छोड़ना), Let go (त्यागना)

2. Gregarious (मिलनसार): Solitary (एकांतप्रिय), Introverted (अंतर्मुखी)

3. Grisly (डरावना): Attractive (आकर्षक), Pleasant (सुखद)

4. Grotesque (घृणित/भद्दा): Attractive (आकर्षक), Plain (साधारण)

5. Grow (बढ़ना): Shrink (सिकुड़ना), Decline (कम होना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Encomium".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Castigation.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Encomium" means a formal expression of high praise. (प्रशंसा)

◦ Example: The retiring professor received an encomium from his colleagues for his decades of dedicated teaching.

 

• "Castigation" means severe criticism or punishment given as a rebuke, and is therefore the correct antonym. (निंदा)

◦ Example: The board's harsh castigation of the manager left him little chance to defend his decisions.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Tribute (श्रद्धांजलि): an act showing gratitude or respect — a synonym of encomium, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Accolade (सम्मान): an expression of praise or approval — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Eulogy (प्रशस्ति): a speech praising someone, often after death — close in sense to encomium.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of encomium: Tribute, Eulogy, Accolade, Praise, Commendation.

• Synonyms of castigation: Criticism, Rebuke, Condemnation, Censure, Reprimand.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Grudge (द्वेष): Benevolence (परोपकार), Kindness (दयालुता)

2. Gruesome (भयानक/कुरूप): Gracious (सुंदर/दयालु), Pleasant (सुखद)

3. Guiltiness (दोषी होना): Innocence (निर्दोषता), Purity (पवित्रता)

4. Guilty (दोषी): Innocent (निर्दोष)

5. Gullible (भोला): Cynical (संशयी), Wise (समझदार)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Inhibit."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Allow.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Inhibit" means to hinder, restrain, or prevent an action or process. (रोकना)

 

• "Allow" means to permit or let something happen. It is therefore the correct antonym. (अनुमति देना)

◦ Example: The new policy will allow employees to work remotely for up to three days each week.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Hinder (बाधा डालना) — to create difficulty or delay for something; a synonym of inhibit.

• Option 3: Suppress (दबाना) — to forcibly put an end to something; a synonym of inhibit.

• Option 4: Restrain (रोकना) — to hold back or control someone; a synonym of inhibit.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of inhibit: Approve, Permit, Enable, Facilitate.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Gumption (समझदारी): Stupidity (मूर्खता), Foolishness (बेवकूफी)

2. Haggard (थका हुआ): Fresh (ताज़ा), Energetic (ऊर्जावान)

3. Happy (खुश): Sad (दुखी), Unhappy (अप्रसन्न)

4. Harass (तंग करना): Comfort (सांत्वना देना), Support (सहायता करना)

5. Hardly ever (बहुत कम): Frequently (अक्सर), Often (बार-बार)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Jeopardise."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Safeguard.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Jeopardise" means to put someone or something at risk of harm or loss. (खतरे में डालना)

 

• "Safeguard" means to protect from harm or damage. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सुरक्षित रखना)

◦ Example: New regulations were introduced to safeguard consumer data from unauthorised access by third-party companies.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Risk (जोखिम में डालना) — to expose someone or something to danger; a synonym of jeopardise.

• Option 2: Imperil (संकट में डालना) — to expose to danger or risk; a synonym of jeopardise.

• Option 3: Endanger (खतरे में डालना) — to put someone or something at risk; a synonym of jeopardise.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of jeopardise: Protect, Secure, Shield.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Harmonious (सामंजस्यपूर्ण): Discordant (असंगत), Conflicting (विरोधी)

2. Harmony (एकता): Strife (कलह), Conflict (संघर्ष)

3. Hazard (जोखिम): Protection (सुरक्षा)

4. Heavy (भारी): Light (हल्का), Weightless (निर्वजन)

5. Hegemony (आधिपत्य): Subordination (अधीनता), Dependence (निर्भरता)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Denounce".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Defend.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Denounce" means to openly criticize or condemn something as wrong. (निंदा करना)

◦ Example: Opposition leaders continued to denounce the new tax bill as unfair to small and medium businesses.

 

• "Defend" means to resist an attack on; to speak or write in support of, and is therefore the correct antonym. (बचाव करना)

◦ Example: The lawyer worked tirelessly to defend her client's reputation against the baseless accusations made in court.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Criticize (आलोचना करना): to point out faults in something — a synonym of denounce, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Condemn (निंदा करना): to express strong disapproval of — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Rebuke (फटकारना): to express sharp disapproval to someone — close in sense to denounce.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of denounce: condemn, criticize, rebuke, censure, denunciate.

• Synonyms of defend: protect, support, uphold, justify.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Heresy (विधर्म): Orthodoxy (परंपरागत विश्वास), Doctrine (सिद्धांत)

2. High (ऊँचा): Low (निम्न)

3. Hinder (रोकना): Facilitate (सहायता करना), Assist (मदद करना)

4. Hit (मारना): Miss (चूकना), Avoid (बचना)

5. Hollow (खाली): Worthwhile (मूल्यवान), Solid (ठोस)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Interesting".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Monotonous.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Interesting" means arousing curiosity or attention; engaging. (दिलचस्प)

◦ Example: The museum's new exhibit offered an interesting glimpse into the daily lives of ancient civilisations.

 

• "Monotonous" means dull and repetitive; lacking variety, and is therefore the correct antonym. (नीरस)

◦ Example: The factory workers complained about the monotonous routine of repeating the same task for eight hours daily.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Captivating (मंत्रमुग्ध करने वाला): capable of holding attention completely — a synonym of interesting, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Fascinating (मनमोहक): extremely interesting or attractive — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Engaging (आकर्षक): attracting attention or interest — close in sense to interesting.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of interesting: Engaging, Fascinating, Captivating, Absorbing, Compelling.

• Synonyms of monotonous: Boring, Tedious, Dull, Repetitive.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Horrible (भयानक): Pleasant (सुखद), Nice (अच्छा)

2. Hospitality (अतिथि सत्कार): Coldness (बेरुख़ी, ठंडापन)

3. Hostile (दुश्मनी): Amiable (मिलनसार), Friendly (मित्रवत)

4. Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण): Friendly (मित्रतापूर्ण), Kind (दयालु)

5. Hot (गरम): Cold (ठंडा), Frigid (बहुत ठंडा)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Ostracize."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Patronize.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Ostracize" means to exclude someone from a group or society; to shun. (बहिष्कार करना)

 

• "Patronize" means to support, sponsor, or treat with favor as a patron. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सहारा देना)

◦ Example: Wealthy donors continued to patronize the struggling theater, ensuring it stayed open for years.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Banish (निर्वासित करना) — to send away or expel from a place; a synonym of ostracize.

• Option 2: Exclude (बाहर रखना) — to prevent from participating; to leave out; a synonym of ostracize.

• Option 4: Shun (त्याग देना) — to avoid or ignore deliberately; a synonym of ostracize.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of ostracize: Accept, Include, Welcome.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Humble (विनम्र): Arrogant (घमंडी)

2. Humidity (नमी): Dryness (शुष्कता), Aridity (सूखापन)

3. Iconoclast (परंपरा तोड़ने वाला): Conformist (परंपरा मानने वाला), Traditionalist (परंपरावादी)

4. Ideal (आदर्श): Faulty (दोषपूर्ण), Imperfect (अपूर्ण)

5. Identity (पहचान): Anonymous (गुमनाम)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Trepidation."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Calm.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Trepidation" means a feeling of fear or anxiety about something that may happen. (घबराहट)

 

• "Calm" means the state of being free from agitation, excitement, or disturbance. It is therefore the correct antonym. (शांत)

◦ Example: Despite the chaos around him, the captain maintained a remarkable calm while directing the rescue operation.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Dread (भय) — great fear or apprehension about a future event; a synonym of trepidation.

• Option 2: Anxiety (चिंता) — a feeling of worry or unease about an event; a synonym of trepidation.

• Option 4: Apprehension (आशंका) — anxiety or fear that something bad will happen; a synonym of trepidation.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of trepidation: Relaxed, Serene, Tranquil.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ignorance (अज्ञान): Knowledge (ज्ञान)

2. Imbroglio (उलझन / जटिल स्थिति): Agreement (समझौता), Harmony (सामंजस्य)

3. Imitate (नकल करना): Originate (मूल रूप से बनाना), Create (सृजन करना)

4. Immaculate (शुद्ध): Filthy (गंदा), Messy (अव्यवस्थित)

5. Immigration (आप्रवासन): Emigration (प्रवासन), Exit (निर्गमन)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Timid."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Daring.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Timid" means showing a lack of courage or confidence; easily frightened. (डरपोक)

 

• "Daring" means willing to take risks; adventurously bold. It is therefore the correct antonym. (साहसी)

◦ Example: The daring mountaineer climbed the icy cliff face without any ropes or safety equipment whatsoever.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Fearful (भयभीत) — feeling afraid; showing fear or anxiety; a synonym of timid.

• Option 3: Meek (विनम्र) — quiet and easily imposed upon; submissive; a synonym of timid.

• Option 4: Shy (शर्मीला) — nervous or timid in company of others; a synonym of timid.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of timid: Bold, Courageous, Fearless.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Immoral (अनैतिक): Decent (नैतिक)

2. Immune (सुरक्षित): Susceptible (असुरक्षित)

3. Immutable (अपरिवर्तनीय): Alterable (परिवर्तनीय), Changeable (बदलने योग्य)

4. Impecunious (निर्धन): Wealthy (धनी), Rich (समृद्ध)

5. Imperious (घमंडी): Meek (विनम्र), Submissive (आज्ञाकारी)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Chided".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Applauded.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Chided" means scolded or expressed disapproval of mildly. (डांटा)

◦ Example: The teacher chided the students for chatting loudly while she was explaining the new chapter.

 

• "Applauded" means expressed approval by clapping or praising, and is therefore the correct antonym. (सराहा)

◦ Example: The crowd applauded the young cricketer as he walked back after scoring a magnificent century.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Reprimanded (फटकारा): rebuked formally — a synonym of chided, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Admonished (चेतावनी दी): warned or reproved gently — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Scolded (डांटा): told off angrily — close in sense to chided.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of chided: scolded, reprimanded, admonished, rebuked, criticized.

• Synonyms of applauded: praised, commended, lauded, complimented, acclaimed.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Impervious (अभेद्य): Permeable (भेद्य), Penetrable (आर-पार होने योग्य)

2. Impetus (प्रोत्साहन): Caution (सावधानी), Hindrance (बाधा)

3. Improvement (सुधार): Deterioration (बिगाड़), Decline (गिरावट)

4. Impute (आरोप लगाना): Defend (बचाव करना), Exonerate (दोषमुक्त करना)

5. Impute (दोष देना): Defend (बचाव करना), Exonerate (दोषमुक्त करना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Utterly".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Minimally.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Utterly" means completely and without qualification; totally. (पूरी तरह)

◦ Example: The plan was utterly ruined after the main investor withdrew funding just two days before launch.

 

• "Minimally" means to the smallest possible extent or degree, and is therefore the correct antonym. (न्यूनतम)

◦ Example: The new policy affected only a minimally small fraction of employees working in the regional offices.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Completely (पूर्णतः): totally; in every way — a synonym of utterly, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Totally (पूर्ण रूप से): completely; entirely — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Wholly (समग्रतः): entirely; totally — close in sense to utterly.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of utterly: Completely, Totally, Wholly, Entirely, Absolutely.

• Synonyms of minimally: Slightly, Barely, Marginally, Partially, Somewhat.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Incandescent (दीप्तिमान): Dusky (अंधकारमय), Dim (मंद)

2. Incessant (निरंतर): Intermittent (रुक-रुक कर), Occasional (कभी-कभी)

3. Incipient (प्रारंभिक): Advanced (उन्नत), Developed (विकसित)

4. Inclement (कठोर): Mild (मृदु), Pleasant (सुखद)

5. Incoherent (असंगत): Rational (तर्कसंगत)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Brittle".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Resilient.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Brittle" means hard but liable to break easily. (भंगुर)

◦ Example: The old glass bangles were so brittle that they shattered the moment they touched the floor.

 

• "Resilient" means able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions; flexible, and is therefore the correct antonym. (लचीला)

◦ Example: The resilient rubber material bent easily under pressure and quickly returned to its original shape.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Crisp (कुरकुरा): hard and dry enough to break easily — a synonym of brittle, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Fragile (नाज़ुक): easily broken or damaged — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Breakable (टूटने वाला): liable to break; not durable — close in sense to brittle.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of brittle: fragile, breakable, crisp, frail, delicate.

• Synonyms of resilient: flexible, tough, elastic, sturdy, durable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Incorrigible (असुधार्य): Reclaimable (सुधार योग्य), Correctable (सुधारने योग्य)

2. Incredible (अद्भुत): Ordinary (साधारण), Normal (सामान्य)

3. Indict (आरोप लगाना): Exonerate (दोषमुक्त करना), Acquit (बरी करना)

4. Indispensable (अति आवश्यक): Superfluous (अनावश्यक), Inessential (गैर-जरूरी)

5. Indolent (आलसी): Active (सक्रिय), Industrious (मेहनती)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Gregarious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Solitary.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Gregarious" means fond of company; sociable and outgoing by nature. (मिलनसार)

◦ Example: Being naturally gregarious, she quickly made friends with everyone at the new office party.

 

• "Solitary" means preferring to be alone; done or existing alone, and is therefore the correct antonym. (एकांतप्रिय)

◦ Example: The old hermit led a solitary life in a small hut deep within the forest.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Friendly (मित्रवत): kind and pleasant toward other people — a synonym of gregarious, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Outgoing (खुले स्वभाव का): friendly and socially confident — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Sociable (मिलनसार): enjoying the company of other people — close in sense to gregarious.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of gregarious: Sociable, Outgoing, Friendly, Extroverted, Convivial.

• Synonyms of solitary: Reclusive, Isolated, Lonely, Withdrawn.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ineffable (अकथनीय): Expressible (कहने योग्य), Definable (परिभाषित करने योग्य)

2. Ineluctable (अनिवार्य): Avoidable (टालने योग्य), Preventable (रोकने योग्य)

3. Inevitable (अनिवार्य): Avoidable (टालने योग्य), Preventable (रोकने योग्य)

4. Infernal (बहुत बुरा): Heavenly (स्वर्गीय), Divine (दैवीय)

5. Infirm (कमजोर): Strong (मजबूत), Healthy (स्वस्थ)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Everlasting."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Transient.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Everlasting" means lasting forever or for a very long time; eternal. (शाश्वत)

 

• "Transient" means lasting only for a short time; temporary. It is therefore the correct antonym. (क्षणिक)

◦ Example: The joy of winning the lottery proved transient for many recipients, who often faced financial ruin within a few years.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Eternal (शाश्वत) — lasting forever; without end; a synonym of everlasting.

• Option 2: Enduring (स्थायी) — continuing for a long time; a synonym of everlasting.

• Option 3: Perpetual (निरंतर) — never ending or changing; a synonym of everlasting.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of everlasting: Fleeting, Temporary, Momentary.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Inflate (फुलाना): Reduce (कम करना), Deflate (सिकुड़ना)

2. Influenced (प्रभावित): Bipartisan (द्विपक्षीय/निष्पक्ष)

3. Inherent (अंतर्निहित): Extraneous (बाहरी)

4. Inhibit (रोकना): Allow (अनुमति देना), Approve (स्वीकृत करना)

5. Innate (जन्मजात): Learned (सीखा हुआ), Acquired (अर्जित)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Anxiety".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Relief.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Anxiety" means a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about an uncertain outcome. (चिंता)

◦ Example: Her anxiety grew steadily as the exam results were delayed for several more days without explanation.

 

• "Relief" means a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from distress, and is therefore the correct antonym. (राहत)

◦ Example: A wave of relief washed over the passengers when the pilot announced the storm had passed.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Worry (चिंता): a state of anxiety over a problem — a synonym of anxiety, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Apprehension (आशंका): anxiety or fear about the future — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Nervousness (घबराहट): the state of being agitated or worried — close in sense to anxiety.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of anxiety: worry, nervousness, apprehension, unease, distress.

• Synonyms of relief: comfort, ease, reassurance, relaxation, solace.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Innocuous (हानिरहित): Harmful (हानिकारक), Dangerous (खतरनाक)

2. Inquisitive (जिज्ञासु): Indifferent (उदासीन), Ignorant (अज्ञानी)

3. Insatiable (अतृप्त): Satisfiable (संतुष्ट किया जा सकने वाला)

4. Insert (डालना): Remove (हटाना)

5. Insipid (फीका): Appetizing (स्वादिष्ट), Flavorful (स्वादपूर्ण)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Barbarity."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Compassion.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Barbarity" means savage cruelty; extreme brutality. (क्रूरता)

 

• "Compassion" means sympathetic concern for the sufferings or misfortunes of others. It is therefore the correct antonym. (दयालुता)

◦ Example: The volunteers treated the injured refugees with great compassion, offering food, shelter, and medical care.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Savagery (बर्बरता) — the quality of being fierce or cruel; a synonym of barbarity.

• Option 3: Brutality (नृशंसता) — savage physical violence; a synonym of barbarity.

• Option 4: Cruelty (क्रूरता) — callous indifference to suffering, or the infliction of it; a synonym of barbarity.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of barbarity: Humanity, Kindness, Mercy.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Intelligible (समझने योग्य): Incoherent (असंगत)

2. Intense (तीव्र): Moderate (मध्यम)

3. Intentional (जानबूझकर): Unplanned (अनायास), Accidental (दुर्घटनावश)

4. Interesting (दिलचस्प): Monotonous (नीरस), Boring (उबाऊ)

5. Interruption (रुकावट): Continuation (निरंतरता), Flow (प्रवाह)
